Fun Facts

  • This station is the last station to be built in 2023.While Relish North Station and Relish South Station both began construction in 2023, as they did not begin services until January 7 2024, these stations are not seen as stations that are built in 2023.</ref>
  • The name of this station '''Leben''' is taken from the German language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which could be directly translated to "Cozy Residence".https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/leben</ref>
  • This station is surrounded by a Diamond Interchange which also serves as the Public Transport Interchange (PTI) of this island. Moreover, additional signages are provided to clear out direction confusion as vehicles passing through this interchange adopts Right-Hand Traffic.
  • In terms of Roads on Leben Island, the concourse of this station is situated at Shingking Road, and the platforms and tracks of this station cut Hipgeoi Avenue in half.
  • Despite being a Ground Station, the platforms are slightly submerged compared to the ground level of this island.
  • The lavatories and Station Control Room of this station are located at the platform level. This arrangement is similar to that of Chosen Surge Station and Airship Island Station respectively.

'''Lei Wah Depot''', originally named Shadow Shore Depot, is a depot constructed for of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and it is located at Los Sengas Cometsilk. However, it also provides services for StarTop Railway .

Description

  • Entrances: Two at the south, One at the north.
  • Hypothetical Capacity: 40 9-Carriage Trains
  • Facilities: Maintenance Pits, Platforms
  • This Depot is located to the west of Shadow Shore Station and Echo Cliffs Station.
  • This Depot can dispatch and retent vehicles from Azure Hook Station, Comet Channel Station, Waterbelt Garden Station, Shadow Shore Station and Echo Cliffs Station without disrupting services of other trains.
  • This Depot also provides vehicular servicing for trains, and is the first depot in Nazca Railway to share facilities with anothe railway company.

Fun Facts

  • The New Chinese name of this depot alludes to the naming of the Reiwa Era which occurred at the time of this depot's construction.
  • This depot completed construction and began services alongside Echo Cliffs Station.
